content: Android Headlines claims to have the specs and price for the entire Pixel 11 lineup. What the site shared basically lines up with everything else that we’ve heard in the lead-up to the August 12th event. The Pixel 11 is expected to get a $100 price hike, starting at $899, but will come with 256GB of storage instead of 128GB in the base model. While the entire lineup will sport the new Tensor G6 and Titan M3 chips, the base model Pixel 11 Pro and Pixel 11 Pro XL are both getting that rumored RAM cut to just 12GB, along with price increases to $1,099 and $1,299, respectively. The Pixel 11 will supposedly ditch the telephoto lens and settle for a dual rear camera setup instead. The pro models appear like they’ll keep the same camera setup from the Pixel 10 lineup. The displays also seem to be largely unchanged from the previous generation. The Pixel 11 Pro Fold wasn’t immune to RAMageddon, either, and will also start with 12GB of RAM and a new price of $1,899.

chineseContent: Android Headlines 声称拥有整个 Pixel 11 系列的规格和价格。该网站分享的内容基本上与我们在 8 月 12 日活动之前听到的所有其他内容一致。 Pixel 11 预计价格上涨 100 美元，起价 899 美元，但将配备 256GB 存储空间，而不是基础型号的 128GB。虽然整个产品线都将配备新的 Tensor G6 和 Titan M3 芯片，但基本型号 Pixel 11 Pro 和 Pixel 11 Pro XL 都将传闻中的 RAM 削减至仅 12GB，并且价格分别上涨至 1,099 美元和 1,299 美元。据推测，Pixel 11 将放弃长焦镜头，采用双后置摄像头设置。 Pro 型号似乎将保留与 Pixel 10 系列相同的相机设置。显示屏似乎与上一代基本没有变化。 Pixel 11 Pro Fold 也未能幸免于 RAMgeddon，起步价为 12GB RAM，新售价为 1,899 美元。
